title: Spain deploys military after thousands of Moroccan migrants cross border illegally; 9 killed
content: Spain deployed its military to Ceuta after thousands of migrants crossed from Morocco.  The sudden influx overwhelmed security forces, leading to a severe border crisis.  Authorities confirmed an agreement with Morocco for the return of illegal migrants.  The reason for the surge remains unclear, with various factors suggested.  Ceuta, a Spanish enclave, is a key point for migration into Europe.

title: Meta India head, social media users booked over PM Modi posts
content: Cybercrime police registered cases against social media account operators and Meta India's head.  These cases involve morphed and objectionable content targeting Prime Minister Narendra Modi.  BJP supporters filed complaints alleging manipulated videos and images were circulated online.  Police are tracing the operators behind the social media accounts involved.  Notices have been issued to Meta regarding the reported objectionable links.

title: 5 killed in Bhiwandi building collapse; several feared trapped
content: A residential building collapsed in Bhiwandi, killing at least five people. Several individuals are feared trapped inside the debris after the structure fell. Rescue teams are actively searching the collapsed building using heavy machinery. The building had been declared dangerous and notices were issued for evacuation. Most families had moved out, but some occupants remained inside.

title: Who is Seema Kaliramna? The mother and PhD scholar who won CWG bronze
content: Seema Kaliramna secured a bronze medal in the women's discus throw at the Commonwealth Games 2026. She achieved a best throw of 58.65 meters, earning India another medal. Kaliramna made an inspiring comeback after motherhood and pursuing her PhD studies. Her husband and coach, Ravinder Kaliramna, played a significant role in her success. She dedicated her medal to her husband's unwavering support and sacrifices.

title: Saudi Arabia, 13 other nations agree to maritime defence alliance amid Red Sea attacks
content: In response to growing threats from Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi rebels, Saudi Arabia has established a new maritime defense coalition focused on securing crucial shipping lanes. This alliance will improve surveillance capabilities and synchronize naval operations in the Red Sea, particularly around the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a pivotal point for international trade. Heightened Houthi activities have raised the stakes and tensions in the area.

title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says he got addicted to this ‘Larry Ellison’s app’
content: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman admitted to becoming addicted to TikTok. He deleted the app after finding its recommendation algorithm too powerful. This occurred as OpenAI abandoned its Sora video generation project. The company cited high computing costs and resource allocation needs. TikTok's US operations are now owned by a new joint venture.

title: 'Your skin brighter than country's future': Dipke's jab at PM's late night video
content: Abhijeet Dipke, CJP founder, mocked Prime Minister Narendra Modi's recent video message.  The Prime Minister discussed the new anti-paper leak Bill passed by Parliament.  This legislation aims to create a more reliable examination system for students.  PM Modi highlighted decades of paper leak issues affecting governments nationwide.  The government is implementing reforms and using technology to ensure exam integrity.

title: Seeking job in US? Trump weighs $100,000 work permit fee from foreign graduates
content: The Trump administration is considering a $100,000 fee for international students' work permits. This proposed charge would impact the Optional Practical Training program significantly. US universities and tech firms could face substantial repercussions from this policy change. The Department of Homeland Security is currently discussing the fee's implementation details. Revised regulations for the OPT program are expected later this fall.

title: NYC targets Uber Eats, DoorDash after Motoclick ban over tip buttons
content: New York City's delivery workers have gained over one hundred million dollars. This increase follows new rules requiring clear tipping options at checkout. Apps like Uber Eats and DoorDash redesigned their interfaces after city enforcement actions. Workers now see significantly higher hourly earnings and more deliveries completed. The administration continues its efforts to improve app-based worker conditions.

title: Who was Billy Ray Smith Jr.? Chargers legend dies at 64 after remarkable career
content: Billy Ray Smith Jr., the former San Diego Chargers linebacker and College Football Hall of Famer, died at 64 after struggling with dementia caused by CTE. Here's everything to know about his life, from his childhood in Arkansas and standout college career to his decade in the NFL, his broadcasting journey, his wife, Kimberly Hunt, his family, and his lasting football legacy. The Chargers legend spent his entire professional career with the franchise and remained a respected voice in sports long after retirement.

title: Hundreds of 'by-the-wind sailors' wash up on England beach — experts warn not to touch
content: Hundreds of exotic-looking marine creatures known as "by-the-wind sailors" washed up along a beach in northwest England after persistent westerly winds pushed them ashore, prompting warnings from wildlife experts not to touch them because of their painful sting. The unusual sight was reported at St Bees beach in Cumbria, where beachgoers stopped to photograph the striking blue creatures scattered across the shoreline.

title: 13-year-old turns peanut shells into pesticide remover, eyes $25K prize
content: Thirteen-year-old Minnesota student Arika Kundu has designed a method that uses discarded peanut shells to help remove pesticide residues from fresh fruits and vegetables. Her project, called LIGNEX, has made her one of 10 finalists in the 2026 3M Young Scientist Challenge. She will now compete for the $25,000 grand prize with guidance from a 3M scientist.

title: Goldman Sachs 'very impressed' with Microsoft's behind-the-scenes improvements
content: Microsoft's AI investments are generating diversified revenue streams, which boosted its stock significantly.  The company reported its fastest cloud revenue acceleration since 2022, showing strong client adoption.  Microsoft 365 Copilot now has over thirty million paid users, a substantial increase.  This performance addresses investor concerns about capital expenditure growth and margin compression.  Analysts see narrowing competitive gaps and rapid enterprise AI use case maturation.

title: When is Neeraj Chopra's CWG 2026 javelin final? All you need to know
content: Neeraj Chopra will compete in the Commonwealth Games 2026 javelin final on August 1. He qualified with a throw of 79.61m amidst difficult stadium conditions. Chopra faces strong competition from Arshad Nadeem and Keshorn Walcott. The final will be held at Scotstoun Stadium in Glasgow, Scotland. Fans can watch the event live on Sony Sports channels and SonyLIV.

title: 'Fed up hogaya tha': Raja Chaudhary on choosing Rs 93 lakh flat over daughter
content: Raja Chaudhary responded to accusations regarding a flat he allegedly accepted for his daughter Palak Tiwari. He revealed that their family court disputes lasted from 2007 to 2012, during which Shweta Tiwari barred him from seeing their daughter. Highlighting his housing woes, Chaudhary insisted he needed a residence and noted that he relinquished his rights to the shared properties.

title: 10 climbers missing after avalanche on Broad Peak in PoK
content: Ten international climbers, including renowned Nepal-born mountaineer Nirmal Purja are missing after an avalanche struck Broad Peak. A tracking device shows Purja's location has shifted, offering a small hope for rescuers. Poor weather has so far prevented helicopters from taking off, delaying aerial search-and-rescue operations. Authorities were preparing to deploy helicopters on Friday morning if weather conditions improved.

title: Why’s CJI not on panel to pick CEC, Supreme Court asks government
content: The Supreme Court questioned Parliament's decision to exclude the Chief Justice of India from the selection panel.  Justices noted the CJI's inclusion in other key appointment committees.  The court heard arguments challenging the 2023 Act's appointment process.  The government urged the court not to question legislative wisdom.  The bench clarified it was not questioning the Prime Minister's trustworthiness.

title: Vivek Oberoi recalls partner saving baby with leukemia as life's biggest reward
content: Actor-entrepreneur Vivek Oberoi has opened up about the setbacks that pushed him to reinvent himself beyond acting, saying he refused to become a "victim" when opportunities dried up. Reflecting on his entrepreneurial journey, he recalled how his business partner rebuilt his life after suffering losses exceeding Rs 100 crore. Oberoi also shared how meeting an eight-month-old leukemia patient named Sahara during Saathiya inspired his lifelong commitment to helping children battling cancer.

title: Indian hockey swaps jerseys — saffron replaces legacy blue
content: Indian hockey has changed its traditional blue jersey to saffron for upcoming tournaments.  This shift has ignited significant criticism from former players and fans alike.  Hockey India cited clashes with blue turf as the primary reason for the alteration.  Players and coaches collectively chose orange, which is part of the Indian tricolour.  The new saffron kits have arrived at national camps for player review.

title: Trump announces 'historic' Gaza deal on Hamas disarmament
content: Donald Trump announced a historic agreement for Hamas disarmament and Israeli withdrawal.  This phased deal will establish a new Palestinian administration in Gaza.  The Board of Peace facilitated this monumental step toward lasting peace and security.  Mediators Egypt, Qatar, and Türkiye were thanked for their important efforts.  Gaza will no longer pose a security threat after this significant progress.

title: Shaunie Henderson reveals revenge after discovering Shaquille O'Neal's affair
content: Shaunie Henderson has openly shared how discovering messages on Shaquille O'Neal's BlackBerry exposed his alleged affairs and ultimately led to the collapse of their marriage. While Henderson recalled confronting the situation in dramatic fashion, O'Neal has repeatedly accepted responsibility, calling himself a "serial cheater" and expressing regret over losing his family. Years after their 2011 divorce, both have rebuilt their lives. Their children have praised the pair's commitment to co-parenting, Henderson has found happiness in her marriage to pastor Keion Henderson.

title: 'No reason to invoke criminal justice': CJP on protesters' derogatory remarks
content: A party spokesperson stated that individuals can pursue defamation cases for offensive language.  He argued that criminal proceedings against protesters for objectionable speech are inappropriate.  The spokesperson urged the younger generation to be mindful of their words and remarks.  He also requested the police to remain calm and avoid misusing their powers.  Noida Police registered a Zero FIR against a woman for alleged abusive language.

title: Liberty vs Aces: Injury report on Satou Sabally, NaLyssa Smith
content: The Liberty and Aces meet Thursday at Michelob ULTRA Arena with both rosters banged up. New York is missing Satou Sabally (concussion) and Leonie Fiebich (foot), while Marine Johannes is questionable with an ankle injury. Las Vegas has ruled out Cheyenne Parker-Tyus (concussion) and lost Janiah Barker for the season, though NaLyssa Smith is expected to suit up despite an undisclosed issue.

title: Anti-paper leak bill clears Parliament; PM says it will build a credible exam system
content: Parliament approved a bill to amend the anti-paper leak law. This legislation introduces stricter punishments for individuals involved in exam malpractices. Prime Minister Modi stated this is a crucial step for a credible exam system. The bill proposes significant jail terms and substantial fines for offenders. It also empowers governments to establish special fast-track courts for these cases.

title: Why Lamine Yamal says he can never repay his mother's sacrifices
content: Lamine Yamal, the 19-year-old World Cup winner, has spoken openly about a childhood shaped by financial hardship and parental sacrifice. His mother, Sheila Ebana, emigrated from Equatorial Guinea to Spain as a teenager, had Yamal at 16, and raised him largely alone after separating from his father when Lamine was three. Yamal credits her with shielding him from the worst of their circumstances, saying she made him see only the beautiful side of life. He also reflected on his rapid rise at Barcelona, describing himself as a creative and entertaining player who never anticipated reaching the first team quite so quickly

title: From delivery rider to entrepreneur: How one accident changed his life
content: After financial hardship forced him to pause his medical studies, Ajit Kumar worked as a food delivery rider, cycling up to 100 kilometres daily to support his family. A serious road accident ended his delivery career but led him to discover writing through Pocket FM. Today, he is the lead writer of the hit audio-fiction series Brahmyodha: The Destroyer, has written over 1,000 episodes, and reportedly earned more than ₹1 crore through digital storytelling.

title: 'We've shared dressing room for so many years': Rohit's heartfelt note for Rahane
content: Ajinkya Rahane represented India in 85 Tests, scoring 5,077 runs, including 12 centuries and 26 fifties, at an average of 38.46. In ODIs, he played 90 matches and scored 2,962 runs, with three centuries and 24 fifties at an average of 35.26. In T20Is, Rahane featured in 20 matches and scored 375 runs, including one half-century.

title: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' scores Rs 70cr opening in India; beats 'Avengers: Endgame'
content: Spider-Man: Brand New Day achieved the biggest opening day for any non-Indian film.  The movie surpassed Avengers: Endgame's previous record with impressive gross collections.  Its Hindi dubbed version showed exceptional audience turnout and high occupancy rates.  Advance bookings for the film also broke previous Hollywood release records.  This historic debut positions the blockbuster for a massive opening weekend.

title: ‘Normal’ July rain defies forecast of El Nino impact
content: India's July monsoon rainfall exceeded expectations, defying earlier forecasts of below-normal precipitation.  This unexpected recovery eased fears of a significant monsoon shortfall for the nation.  However, rainfall distribution remained uneven across different regions of the country.  Experts now emphasize that El Nino alone cannot explain India's changing rainfall behaviour.  Climate change is increasingly altering monsoon patterns, making predictions more complex.

title: Isro hiring for 746 posts barely skims record vacancy backlog
content: Isro and DoS have initiated a significant recruitment drive for 746 positions.  These openings include regular posts and apprenticeship opportunities for future talent.  The drive aims to address a notable vacancy rate within the space department.  Administrative roles and scientist/engineer positions are being filled across various centers.  This effort seeks to bolster Isro's workforce and operational capabilities.

title: 'If we were funded from abroad, Shah should quit; I refused offer to join BJP': Dipke
content: Abhijeet Dipke claims BJP offered him membership and issued threats during a student protest. He questioned Union Home Minister Amit Shah's role and demanded his resignation. Dipke criticized the police action at Jantar Mantar and Union Minister Pralhad Joshi's remarks. He defended young people and advised Baba Ramdev to focus on his products. Dipke stated police should not fear filming if acting lawfully.

title: Mileage drop due to E20? 2-6%, says 1 minister, 3-5%, says another
content: Government ministries have offered varied figures regarding fuel efficiency changes.  Older vehicles using E20 fuel may see a slight mileage reduction.  The Road Transport Ministry cited a 2-6% potential decrease in efficiency.  The Petroleum Ministry indicated a general reduction of about 3-5%.  Both ministries stressed that fuel economy depends on driving and maintenance factors.

title: Liti's 223kg stunner denies Lovepreet CWG gold by 1kg in weightlifting
content: Liti produced a Commonwealth Games record lift of 223kg in the clean and jerk to move ahead of the Indian and win gold with a total of 389kg, just one kilogram more than Lovepreet. Liti had lifted 166kg in the snatch.

title: Rishab Shetty lauds Nitesh Tiwari's 'Ramayana' trailer
content: Kantara star Rishab Shetty shared his appreciation for the Ramayana-The Introduction trailer. He lauded the film's convincing cinematic world and the team's efforts. Shetty also praised the cast for their responsible portrayal of iconic mythological figures. He highlighted Ranbir Kapoor's divine presence and Yash's impactful performance as Raavana. The music by A.R. Rahman and Hans Zimmer further elevated the trailer's emotions.

title: DeenTheGreat's lawyer makes fresh claim amid 15-year prison risk
content: Streamer DeenTheGreat, whose real name is Nurideen Shabazz, is facing felony robbery and misdemeanor battery charges linked to an alleged yacht incident in Miami. If convicted, he could face up to 15 years in prison. His lawyer says prosecutors are expected to dismiss the case soon, but the charges remain active ahead of his August 4 court hearing.

title: Supreme Court: No blanket ban on use of pellet guns for crowd control
content: The Supreme Court ordered the Delhi government to treat all injured protesters.  It questioned the feasibility of banning pellet guns for crowd control.  The court directed the preservation of ammunition logs for effective investigation.  It also emphasized the need for police to have adequate safety gear.  The bench reiterated that peaceful protests can sometimes be hijacked by miscreants.

title: 16 Indians, including 10 seamen, killed in Middle East conflict: Government
content: Sixteen Indian nationals, including ten seafarers, have died in the West Asia conflict. Seventy-five other Indian nationals sustained injuries in the same regional conflict. In a separate incident, twelve Indian nationals perished at Qatar's Ras Laffan Gas Facility. The government is coordinating with host nations to repatriate mortal remains. Injured individuals received medical treatment and necessary assistance from Indian missions.

title: Release 3,500 cusecs of water to Tamil Nadu: Cauvery authority to Karnataka
content: The Cauvery Water Management Authority ordered Karnataka to release 3,500 cusecs daily. This directive mandates a total release of 4 TMC of water to Tamil Nadu. Karnataka had appealed the committee's order citing low reservoir levels and drought conditions. State officials stated reservoir levels were significantly lower than last year. Tamil Nadu representatives argued against Karnataka's plea, citing sufficient flow.

title: 'Jana Nayagan' BO day 8: Thalapathy Vijay's film earns Rs 3.98 crore
content: Thalapathy Vijay's Jana Nayagan saw collections decrease on its eighth day. The film's India net total reached over 153 crore rupees. Worldwide gross collections for Jana Nayagan have now surpassed 260 crore. The Tamil version continues to be the primary revenue driver. Collections are following an expected weekday trend after its opening.

title: Formal retail credit access doubles over past decade
content: Formal retail credit penetration in India more than doubled over the past decade.  Consumption-led lending, including personal loans, drove this significant growth.  Credit access expanded to younger borrowers and women across India.  Northern and central states saw increased credit activity, while western and southern regions moderated.  This shift reflects credit being used for lifestyle rather than asset acquisition.

title: Gabrielle Union reveals why she nearly walked away from Dwyane Wade
content: Dwyane Wade and Gabrielle Union have been through a lot in their marriage as the actres opens up about the darkest phase of their marriage.

title: Despite unrest, PM Modi, Amit Shah haven't spoken on NEET protests: Opposition
content: Rajya Sabha saw a political storm after Mallikarjun Kharge questioned Amit Shah's absence and silence.  He clarified his remarks meant people's power for accountability, not physical force.  Opposition MPs questioned the effectiveness of the new anti-paper leak bill.  Several parties demanded the government scrap the NEET exam.  The debate highlighted ongoing concerns about student protests and exam integrity.

title: From 617 to 2,000 in 2025, Indians deported from US triple since 2023
content: Four hundred fourteen Indians faced deportation from the US by March 2026. Deportations from the US significantly increased from 2023 to 2025. The United Kingdom and Cyprus also deported Indians, with fifty-seven and fifty-three respectively. Government data shows thousands of unregistered agents were notified on the eMigrate portal. Indian truckers arrested in Arizona are also facing deportation proceedings.

title: Muhammad Ali's timeless lesson on service, courage, and purpose
content: Muhammad Ali’s life was about much more than boxing. From a stolen bicycle that introduced him to the sport to sacrificing his career for his beliefs, he stayed true to his values. His love for family, commitment to helping others, and courage during difficult times turned him into an inspiration whose legacy continues to reach people across generations.

title: Middle East conflict: PM Modi reviews safety of seafarers, supply chain constraints
content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi chaired a special security meeting concerning the West Asia crisis.  He directed the establishment of a mechanism to aid seafarers and their families.  Discussions also covered ensuring uninterrupted fertilizer supply for the upcoming rabi season.  The government's strategy to diversify energy sources has mitigated risks effectively.  A whole-of-government approach is being continued to safeguard citizens' interests.

title: Parliament passes Vande Mataram bill
content: Parliament passed the Prevention of Insults to National Honour Bill on Thursday. This amendment extends legal protection to the national song Vande Mataram. The DMK opposed the bill, citing concerns about national division and imposition. The BJP defended the amendment, emphasizing respect for the complete Vande Mataram song. This action places Vande Mataram on par with the national anthem for legal protection.

title: ‘Pluto’ movie review: A sci-fi comedy that sticks to usual alien narratives
content: Sci-fi films are not something that happens often in the Malayalam film industry which has relatively smaller budgets, with the subgenre of sci-fi comedies appearing even less frequently. Even the rarity of the genre does not really work to the advantage of Pluto.

title: Out of society’s mind, the mentally ill in Kerala’s government mental health centres yearn for compassion
content: The inmates of State-run mental health centres in Kerala are living in abominable conditions. Acute shortage of staff and facilities plagues Government Mental Health Centre, Thrissur. Fifty-five inmates in the Thiruvananthapuram centre and around 40 in  Thrissur are fit to be discharged. Yet, with no one to take them home or no place to go, they continue to live in the centres.  Relapses have forced some others to return to the cells
